stem: Voltmarkt's headphone promo share of sales is 35%. A category manager says: "So our promotions brought in 35% extra revenue." What is wrong with this reading?

options.text: Promo share is the share of revenue sold on deal, not extra revenue
The claim holds once markdown lines are taken out of the promotion revenue
Promo share counts units sold on deal, so it says nothing about revenue
The 35% has to be divided by the discount depth to give extra revenue
